scope: Read-only mathematical/source review of standalone helper; no execution, model evaluation, training, or validation access
findings: Symmetric spatial traction (G+G^T)n_body is correct for dimensionless velocity gradient d(u/U)/d(x/D); supplied unit body normal must equal negative fluid-domain normal.
Weights ds/D and singular-value-squared weighted sum of mode traction errors divided by one frozen global teacher traction energy form a dimensionless additive objective.
Zero individual traction-energy modes remain supported; no unstable per-mode division.
Pressure and Reynolds factors are absent intentionally for spatial viscous mode regression; actual force coefficient contraction requires 2/Re and pressure/lift terms remain separate.
Normal sign cancels in the squared loss but not in signed integrated traction diagnostics; explicit body-normal binding is still necessary.

The synthetic coefficient construction supports covariance diag(sigma squared); actual TRAIN coefficient compatibility must bind the existing accepted certificate, not assume arbitrary online coefficients.
